newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT FALLS 4.79 PCT ON INT'L CALL PRICE CUT.
newsitem.headline: PLDT FALLS 4.79 PCT ON INT'L CALL PRICE CUT.

text.p: Shares of the Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co fell 45 pesos, or 4.79 percent, to 895 pesos in late trade on Monday, on foreign selling sparked by news that U.S. regulators had approved rules aimed at cutting the price of overseas phone calls.

"It's due mainly to the news about a decline in accounting rates. We have known long before that there will be a cut but how much, we are not certain yet and that creates anxiety," said Mayenne Katimbang, research head at Magnum International Securities.
